claim: Try it with sample data loads three sample notes without changing your notebook.
sandbox: Save one real note, open /demo, inspect three seeded notes, then start for real and confirm the real note remains.

claim: Shows the latest successful setup on the home screen.
sandbox: Create a successful demo setup and assert its place, mode, and volume appear in the home recall.

claim: Searches saved setups by the words in the note.
sandbox: Use /demo history and search a realistic sample observation; assert exactly the matching note remains.

claim: Exports saved setups as JSON and CSV.
sandbox: Download both demo exports, parse JSON, and inspect the CSV header and one row per sample note.

claim: Imports a valid Hearing Mode Notes JSON backup.
sandbox: Upload a complete bundled JSON fixture in /demo and confirm its saved place appears in history.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Use a dedicated browser context, wait for the worker to control /demo, go offline, reload, and assert sample output remains.

claim: Keeps notes on your device with no microphone or third-party tracking requests.
sandbox: Instrument microphone access and record all network requests during a demo history flow; assert zero microphone calls and only the product origin.

claim: Requests location only after you press Add current location.
where: Landing facts, note form, privacy page
sandbox: Instrument geolocation, open a demo note, assert no call before the button, then assert one call after it.

claim: Does not connect to or control hearing aids.
sandbox: Instrument the browser device-connection API during a representative demo flow and assert no connection request occurs.

claim: Lets you choose light, dark, or system appearance.
sandbox: Select each setting in demo Settings and assert the document theme state changes to that exact choice.

claim: Lets you add a reusable place tab.
sandbox: Add a named place in demo Settings, open a new note, and assert the new tab is available.

claim: Shows the saved setup when notifications are unavailable.
sandbox: Disable the notification API in demo mode, request a reminder, and assert the reminder text is shown.
